archetypes.name: dyn-voter-routing
archetypes.rationale: Codex-primary voter routing has several fallback and legacy-log compatibility paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed code-review voter defaults and dispatch tests. Focus on whether voter 1 now selects Codex first, falls back to Cursor and then Claude, and still preserves the both-externals-down single-Claude anchor. Check that legacy cursor-validity labels remain readable without changing compact historical v1 semantics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
